fixes.find: A mini-split needs a three-inch sleeve through one wall. That is the whole penetration. Line set, control cable and drain share a single hole, pitched down to shed water.
fixes.replace: A single-zone mini-split often needs only a small sleeve through one wall, sized to the manufacturer's line set and drain requirements. Multiple heads, fire-rated walls and condensate routes can need more penetrations or more work. Where the line set, control cable and drain share one hole, it is pitched down to shed water.
